directives.title: Enforce Mandatory Coastal Evacuation within 5km High-Tide Belt
Hoist Great Danger Signal No. 10 at Paradip & Dhamra Ports
directives.target: Paradip Port Authority, Dhamra Port Co.
directives.completionNote: Signal 10 active. Berth evacuations complete; shipping channel cleared.

directives.title: Pre-position NDRF & ODRAF Battalions with Tree Cutters & Inflatable Boats
directives.target: 18 Teams in Odisha, 14 Teams in West Bengal
directives.completionNote: 32 total teams prepositioned with satellite phones and flood rescue boats.

directives.title: Execute Pre-emptive Controlled De-energization of 33kV Coastal Feeders
directives.completionNote: Automatic trip programmed when surface wind sustained >65 km/h.

directives.title: Deploy 50 Mobile Medical Relief Units & Chlorination Supplies
directives.target: All coastal Block Primary Health Centers
directives.completionNote: 2.4M water purification tablets, anti-venom and trauma kits delivered.

directives.title: Activate SATPHONE & High Frequency (HF) Ham Radio Fallback Network
directives.completionNote: ISAT-2 phones operational across all 14 coastal control rooms.
